name: bespok3d-daemon
title: Bespok3d daemon
description: The on-printer daemon for the Bespok3d plugin manager: a small FastAPI service that installs, updates, and removes plugins, reports printer capabilities, refuses any operation mid-print, and self-heals a plugin that breaks a service so the printer is never left unusable. It is plugin zero: the adapter bootstraps it over SSH at enrollment (cert-pinned HTTPS, bearer-token auth), not through the normal plugin install pipeline, so the install block below is intentionally empty. This package is the publishable, versioned artifact the app reads to know when a newer daemon is available.
tagline: The on-printer service that installs plugins and keeps the printer safe.
